# what: Compiler Explorer panes for #2792, captured in full.
#       `triage.py godbolt` records only the FIRST line of each pane, which here
#       is an environment warning -- so the tool can print nothing of the
#       finding while the link itself is perfect. SKILL.md step 7 warns about
#       exactly this ("Open the link."), so the panes are captured here instead.
# how:  cd .github/skills/dxc-issue-triage && python data/issues/2792/ce-panes.py
# ran:  2026-08-07T05:12:39+00:00
#
# SECTION 1 below runs the PIXEL repro (repro.hlsl) and its controls. It is
# what established that a Clang pane on the pixel form is stage noise: the
# one-line control shader fails with the SAME "Unsupported intrinsic
# llvm.dx.store.output.f32 for DXIL lowering" error as the repro, so the error
# is about the shader stage and says nothing about this issue.
#
# The two Clang root-signature controls are the reason the Clang result is
# reported the way it is: clang DOES parse and check root signature syntax
# (a malformed one gives "invalid parameter of RootSignature"), but it does NOT
# diagnose a root signature that binds b1 while the cbuffer sits at b0 -- which
# DXC does reject. So clang has no root-signature-vs-shader checking at all
# yet, and its silence on #2792's repro is "not implemented there either",
# not independent confirmation that the shader is fine.
#
# SECTION 2 is the verification of the PUBLISHED link, which uses the compute
# restatement (compute-translation.hlsl) so all three compilers can answer the
# same question. Panes are re-compiled from the source actually stored in the
# shortlink, not from the local file.
#
# DXIL bodies are trimmed; rerun the command above for the full output.
